headline: Malden Housing Authority to review bills, invoices, contract change orders, charitable requests, and capital project payments.
summary: The board will approve payment of bills, invoices, dues, and contract change orders, and will review policies, contracts, charitable requests, correspondence, capital project invoices, and training offerings.
items: Approval of Bills and Signing of Checks
Approval of Payment of Invoices, Dues, Requests for Payments and Contract Change Orders
Review of Approved for Payment Capital Project Invoices, Requisitions for Payment, and all other applicable Project Documentation
Review of Approved Training and Conference Offerings
location: Library, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148 (also via Zoom)
